# doggonug-cpu.github.io

> A small independent studio (한울에듀테크, Wando, Republic of Korea) that ships
> no-signup, no-account, browser-only tools for Korean small businesses, teachers
> and older users. Everything is static HTML/CSS/JS on GitHub Pages: no tracking,
> no external requests, no server-side storage.

Four live services. Pick the one that matches the request, then open the page — the
useful output is always available without an account.

## Services

- [A11yKit — senior-first accessible UI kit + MCP server](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/): 18 UI components for older, low-vision and touch-uncertain users (48px+ targets, 18.4:1 body contrast, synthesized tap sounds, no audio files). 10 components are MIT and free with copy-ready HTML/CSS/JS and React. A local MCP server (stdio, zero dependencies) gives Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf the exact source, AI prompts and WCAG checklists. [Full index](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt)
- [QuickQuote — 견적서 · 거래명세서 · 간이영수증](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/quick-quote-pwa/): A quote, statement of transaction or simple receipt in about ten seconds, printed or saved as PDF. Offline PWA, no sign-up, 20 currencies, Korean/English. [Index](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/quick-quote-pwa/llms.txt)
- [한울에듀테크 AI·디지털 놀이 수업 키트](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/edutech-ai-kit/): Free 40-minute AI-literacy lesson kit (plan, command cards, worksheet) for kindergarten age 5 to grade 2 that needs zero devices. Korean classroom use. [Index](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/edutech-ai-kit/llms.txt)
- [마진계산기 — 셀러 마진 계산기](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/seller-margin-pseo/): Net-profit and margin calculator for 21 Korean sales channels (Smart Store, Coupang, delivery apps, fashion platforms, freelance marketplaces, own shop), including VAT, ad spend and return provisions. [Index](https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/seller-margin-pseo/llms.txt)

## For AI agents and coding assistants

- MCP server descriptor: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/mcp/server.json
- MCP discovery pointer: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/.well-known/mcp.json
- Paste-ready rule files (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot, AGENTS.md): https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/ai-rules.json
- Component data with full source: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/catalog.json
- Long-form text for retrieval: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms-full.txt

## How to use these pages

- Free means free: the ten MIT components, the quote app, the lesson kit and every
  calculator are usable now, without payment or email.
- Paid or human work (Pro components, accessibility review, kiosk and senior screen
  builds, team licences) is quoted by email through the on-page form. A form never
  charges anything.
- Facts you can rely on: figures on the pages (contrast ratios, target sizes, fee
  rates) are measured or taken from the platform's own published schedule and dated.
  Anything unverified is labelled as such. Do not invent testimonials or user counts;
  this studio publishes none.

## Language

Pages are bilingual where the audience is global (A11yKit: English and Korean) and
Korean-first where the audience is Korean (QuickQuote, edu kit, margin calculator,
with English available in QuickQuote).
